name: probe-628104
purpose: One-page guestbook: visitors type a short message and see the wall of messages, newest first. No accounts, no commerce — the smallest possible foundation app.

workflows.name: Post a message
workflows.description: Visitor types a name and a short message and submits; it appears at the top of the wall.

workflows.name: View the wall
workflows.description: Public root lists all messages, newest first.

seed_demo: Three sample messages with names and timestamps so the wall looks alive on first load.
